PLAY · LIVING AND NONLIVING

Panda’s Living or Nonliving Discovery

Panda is sorting the world into LIVING and NONLIVING! Tap all the living things. Living things grow, eat and breathe.

Tap all the living things!

0 of 3 found

Living things found!

The tree, the butterfly and the baby rabbit are alive. Cars, rocks and chairs never grow!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Living/nonliving is the first brick of biology. The best test for a four-year-old: does it GROW, does it EAT, does it BREATHE? A car drinks petrol — but it never grows!

Prefer paper? The Panda’s Living or Nonliving Discovery worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
